haikus.haiku:
Egg yolk glows soft bright
Creamy spice twirls on plate near
Guests cheer with egg grin
Happy #NationalDeviledEggDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft snow circles glow
Children trace bright shapes in air
Warm smiles round the hill
Happy #LookForCirclesDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft cake sighs, sweet glow
Laughter rings through bright soft halls
Birthday candles dance
#HappyBirthdayBurtLancaster from @ClamBakeSanta
